_readme: Voice scripts for Kobo Kobo. Edit TEXT only; never remove or rename a {slot}. A segment is either a string (core: never dropped), [text, weight] (optional: dropped lowest weight first when the audio would be too long) or [text, weight, 'slot'] (only used when that slot has a value). status: 'approved' = a native speaker reviewed it; 'draft' = written by an AI, usable for demos only. Amounts are spoken in English words in every language (Nigerians commonly say money in English). Keywords YES/NO must stay in English: the SMS handler matches them. The keywords RESUME and YES stay in English: the SMS handler matches them.

en.note: Read by a Nigerian Pidgin voice: 9jaLingo has no plain-English voice. Check the accent.

en: Hello, this is Kobo Kobo, your pension helper.
Press one to hear your balance.
Press two to hear what we saved today.
Press nine to hear this again.
pidgin: Hello, na Kobo Kobo, your pension helper.
Press one make you hear your balance.
Press two make you hear wetin we save today.
Press nine make you hear this one again.
yoruba: Báwo ni, èyí ni Kobo Kobo, olùrànlọ́wọ́ owó ìfẹ̀yìntì yín.
Ẹ tẹ ọ̀kan láti gbọ́ iye owó yín.
Ẹ tẹ èjì láti gbọ́ ohun tí a fi pamọ́ lónìí.
Ẹ tẹ ẹ̀sán láti gbọ́ èyí lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.
hausa: Sannu, wannan Kobo Kobo ne, mataimakin fansho naku.
Ku danna daya don jin ma'aunin kuɗinku.
Ku danna biyu don jin abin da muka ajiye yau.
Ku danna tara don sake jin wannan.
igbo: Ndewo, nke a bụ Kobo Kobo, onye inyeaka ụgwọ ezumike nka gị.
Pịa otu ka ị nụrụ ego ị nwere.
Pịa abụọ ka ị nụrụ ihe anyị chekwara taa.
Pịa itoolu ka ị nụrụ nke a ọzọ.

en: Sorry, we did not get that.
pidgin: Sorry, we no understand wetin you press.
yoruba: Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, a kò gbọ́ ohun tí ẹ tẹ.
hausa: Yi hakuri, ba mu fahimci abin da kuka danna ba.
igbo: Biko gbaghara, anyị aghọtaghị ihe ị pịrị.

en: Thank you for saving with Kobo Kobo. Goodbye.
pidgin: Thank you say you dey save with Kobo Kobo. Bye bye.
yoruba: Ẹ ṣeun tí ẹ ń fi owó pamọ́ pẹ̀lú Kobo Kobo. Ó dìgbà.
hausa: Mun gode da ajiya tare da Kobo Kobo. Sai an jima.
igbo: Daalụ maka ichekwa ego gị na Kobo Kobo. Ka ọ dị.

en: Sorry, we could not find your account. Please dial the Kobo Kobo code to register. Goodbye.
pidgin: Sorry, we no see your account. Abeg dial the Kobo Kobo code make you register. Bye bye.
yoruba: Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, a kò rí àkántì yín. Ẹ pe kóòdù Kobo Kobo láti forúkọ sílẹ̀. Ó dìgbà.
hausa: Yi hakuri, ba mu sami asusunku ba. Don Allah ku danna lambar Kobo Kobo don yin rajista. Sai an jima.
igbo: Biko gbaghara, anyị ahụghị akaụntụ gị. Biko pịa koodu Kobo Kobo ka ịdebanye aha. Ka ọ dị.

en: Your latest figures are not ready yet. Please try again later. Goodbye.
pidgin: Your latest figures never ready yet. Abeg try again later. Bye bye.
yoruba: Àwọn ìṣirò yín tuntun kò tíì parí. Ẹ jọ̀wọ́ ẹ tún gbìyànjú lẹ́yìn náà. Ó dìgbà.
hausa: Sabbin alkaluman ku ba su kammala ba tukuna. Don Allah ku sake gwadawa daga baya. Sai an jima.
igbo: Ọnụ ọgụgụ gị kacha ọhụrụ adịbeghị njikere. Biko nwaa ọzọ mgbe e mesịrị. Ka ọ dị.

en: For your safety, Kobo Kobo reads your balance only when we call you. Please dial the Kobo Kobo code and ask for a call. Goodbye.
pidgin: For your safety, Kobo Kobo dey read your balance only when we call you. Abeg dial the Kobo Kobo code make you ask for call. Bye bye.
yoruba: Fún ààbò yín, Kobo Kobo ń ka iye owó yín nígbà tí a bá pè yín nìkan. Ẹ pe kóòdù Kobo Kobo kí ẹ bèèrè fún ìpè. Ó dìgbà.
hausa: Don tsaron ku, Kobo Kobo yana karanta ma'aunin kuɗinku ne kawai idan mun kira ku. Don Allah ku danna lambar Kobo Kobo ku nemi kira. Sai an jima.
igbo: Maka nchekwa gị, Kobo Kobo na-agụ ego ị nwere naanị mgbe anyị kpọrọ gị. Biko pịa koodu Kobo Kobo ma rịọ ka anyị kpọọ gị. Ka ọ dị.

en: {name_prefix}Your total pension savings is {total}.
Your emergency pot has {emergency}.
Your retirement pot has {retirement}.
You can withdraw from your emergency pot now.
Your retirement pot stays locked until you are fifty.
Well done.
pidgin: {name_prefix}Your total pension money na {total}.
For emergency pot, {emergency} dey.
For retirement pot, {retirement} dey.
You fit withdraw from your emergency pot now.
Your retirement pot go stay locked till you reach fifty years.
Well done!
yoruba: {name_prefix}Àpapọ̀ owó ìfẹ̀yìntì yín jẹ́ {total}.
Owó pàjáwìrì yín jẹ́ {emergency}.
Owó ìfẹ̀yìntì yín jẹ́ {retirement}.
Ẹ lè yọ owó pàjáwìrì yín báyìí.
Owó ìfẹ̀yìntì yóò wà ní títì títí ẹ ó fi pé àádọ́ta ọdún.
Ẹ ṣeun.
hausa: {name_prefix}Jimillar kuɗin fansho naku shi ne {total}.
Asusun gaggawa yana da {emergency}.
Asusun ritaya yana da {retirement}.
Kuna iya cire kuɗin gaggawa yanzu.
Za a rufe asusun ritaya har sai kun kai shekara hamsin.
Mun gode.
igbo: {name_prefix}Ngụkọta ego ezumike nka gị bụ {total}.
Ego mberede gị bụ {emergency}.
Ego ezumike nka gị bụ {retirement}.
Ị nwere ike iwepụ ego mberede gị ugbu a.
A ga-akpọchi ego ezumike nka gị ruo mgbe ị ga-erue afọ iri ise.
Daalụ.

Your first savings will come from your next sales.
pidgin: {name_prefix}You never save anything yet.
Your first savings go come from your next sales.
yoruba: {name_prefix}Ẹ kò tíì fi nǹkan kan pamọ́.
Ìfipamọ́ àkọ́kọ́ yín yóò wá láti ara ọjà yín tó kàn.
hausa: {name_prefix}Ba ku riga kun ajiye komai ba.
Ajiyarku ta farko za ta fito daga sayarwarku ta gaba.
igbo: {name_prefix}Ịchekwabeghị ihe ọ bụla.
Nchekwa mbụ gị ga-esite n'ahịa gị na-esote.

en: {name_prefix}Today you sold {takings}.
We saved {sweep} for your pension.
{emergency} went to your emergency pot and {retirement} to your retirement pot.
We also found one big payment of {held_amount} and did not save from it yet. Please check your text messages.
held_amount
Well done.
pidgin: {name_prefix}Today you sell {takings}.
We save {sweep} for your pension.
{emergency} enter emergency pot, {retirement} enter retirement pot.
We also see one big payment, {held_amount}. We never save from am yet. Check your text message.
held_amount
Well done!
yoruba: {name_prefix}Ọjà tí ẹ tà lónìí jẹ́ {takings}.
A fi {sweep} pamọ́ fún owó ìfẹ̀yìntì yín.
{emergency} lọ sínú owó pàjáwìrì, {retirement} sì lọ sínú owó ìfẹ̀yìntì.
A tún rí owó ńlá kan, {held_amount}. A kò tíì fi pamọ́ nínú rẹ̀. Ẹ jọ̀wọ́ ẹ wo ìfiránṣẹ́ orí fóònù yín.

igbo: {name_prefix}Taa, ire ahịa gị bụ {takings}.

{emergency} banyere n'ego mberede, {retirement} banyekwara n'ego ezumike nka.
Anyị hụkwara nnukwu ego otu, {held_amount}. Anyị achekwabeghị ya. Biko lelee ozi ekwentị gị.
held_amount

We also found one big payment of {held_amount} and did not save from it yet. Please check your text messages.
held_amount

No wahala. We go see tomorrow.
We also see one big payment, {held_amount}. We never save from am yet. Check your text message.
held_amount
yoruba: {name_prefix}Kò sí títà lónìí, nítorí náà a kò fi nǹkan pamọ́.
Kò sí wàhálà. Ẹ ó rí wa lọ́la.
A tún rí owó ńlá kan, {held_amount}. A kò tíì fi pamọ́ nínú rẹ̀. Ẹ jọ̀wọ́ ẹ wo ìfiránṣẹ́ orí fóònù yín.

held_amount
igbo: {name_prefix}Enweghị ahịa taa, ya mere anyị echekwaghị ihe ọ bụla.
Enweghị nsogbu. Ka ọ dị echi.
Anyị hụkwara nnukwu ego otu, {held_amount}. Anyị achekwabeghị ya. Biko lelee ozi ekwentị gị.

en: {name_prefix}Today you sold {takings}, but we did not save anything tonight.
Saving continues with your next sales.
pidgin: {name_prefix}Today you sell {takings}, but we no save anything tonight.
Saving go continue with your next sales.
yoruba: {name_prefix}Ọjà tí ẹ tà lónìí jẹ́ {takings}, ṣùgbọ́n a kò fi nǹkan pamọ́ lálẹ́ yìí.
Ìfipamọ́ yóò tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ọjà yín tó kàn.
hausa: {name_prefix}Yau kun sayar da kaya na {takings}, amma ba mu ajiye komai ba a daren nan.
Ajiya za ta ci gaba da sayarwarku ta gaba.
igbo: {name_prefix}Taa, ire ahịa gị bụ {takings}, ma anyị echekwaghị ihe ọ bụla n'abalị a.
Nchekwa ga-aga n'ihu site n'ahịa gị na-esote.

en: {name_prefix}Today you sold {takings}, but we saved nothing so that your account keeps a small balance for you.
Saving continues with your next sales.
pidgin: {name_prefix}Today you sell {takings}, but we no save anything so that small money go remain for your account.
Saving go continue with your next sales.
yoruba: {name_prefix}Ọjà tí ẹ tà lónìí jẹ́ {takings}, ṣùgbọ́n a kò fi nǹkan pamọ́ kí owó díẹ̀ lè ṣẹ́kù nínú àkántì yín.
Ìfipamọ́ yóò tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ọjà yín tó kàn.
hausa: {name_prefix}Yau kun sayar da kaya na {takings}, amma ba mu ajiye komai ba don asusunku ya ci gaba da samun ɗan kuɗi.
Ajiya za ta ci gaba da sayarwarku ta gaba.
igbo: {name_prefix}Taa, ire ahịa gị bụ {takings}, ma anyị echekwaghị ihe ọ bụla ka obere ego fọdụrụ n'akaụntụ gị.
Nchekwa ga-aga n'ihu site n'ahịa gị na-esote.

en: {name_prefix}Your saving is paused, so nothing was saved today.
To start again, send RESUME by text message.
pidgin: {name_prefix}Your saving don pause, so we no save anything today.
To start again, send RESUME for text message.
yoruba: {name_prefix}A ti dá ìfipamọ́ yín dúró, nítorí náà a kò fi nǹkan pamọ́ lónìí.
Láti tún bẹ̀rẹ̀, ẹ fi RESUME ránṣẹ́ nípasẹ̀ ìfiránṣẹ́ orí fóònù.
hausa: {name_prefix}An dakatar da ajiyarku, don haka ba mu ajiye komai ba yau.
Don sake farawa, ku aika RESUME ta saƙon waya.
igbo: {name_prefix}A kwụsịrị nchekwa gị, ya mere anyị echekwaghị ihe ọ bụla taa.
Ka ịmalite ọzọ, zipu RESUME site n'ozi ekwentị.

en: {name_prefix}Your sales have been steady.
We suggest moving your pension saving from {rate_cur} to {rate_new}.
This adds about {monthly_change} every month.
To agree, reply YES to the text message we sent.
If you do nothing, your rate stays the same.
pidgin: {name_prefix}Your sales dey steady.
We wan move your pension saving from {rate_cur} to {rate_new}.
E go add about {monthly_change} every month.
If you agree, reply YES for the text message wey we send.
If you no do anything, your rate go stay as e be.
yoruba: {name_prefix}Títà yín ti dúró ṣinṣin.
A dábàá pé kí a gbé ìfipamọ́ owó ìfẹ̀yìntì yín láti {rate_cur} sí {rate_new}.
Èyí yóò fi bí {monthly_change} kún un lóṣooṣù.
Tí ẹ bá fọwọ́ sí i, ẹ fèsì YES sí ìfiránṣẹ́ tí a rán sí yín.
Tí ẹ kò bá ṣe nǹkan kan, ìpín yín yóò wà bí ó ṣe wà.
hausa: {name_prefix}Sayarwarku ta tsaya daram.
Muna ba da shawarar mu ƙara ajiyar fansho naku daga {rate_cur} zuwa {rate_new}.
Wannan zai ƙara kusan {monthly_change} kowane wata.
Idan kun yarda, ku amsa YES ga saƙon da muka aika.
Idan ba ku yi komai ba, adadin ajiyarku zai tsaya yadda yake.
igbo: {name_prefix}Ahịa gị na-aga nke ọma.
Anyị na-atụ aro ka anyị bulie nchekwa ụgwọ ezumike nka gị site na {rate_cur} ruo {rate_new}.
Nke a ga-agbakwunye ihe dị ka {monthly_change} kwa ọnwa.
Ọ bụrụ na ị kwenyere, zaa YES n'ozi anyị zitere.
Ọ bụrụ na ị emeghị ihe ọ bụla, oke gị ga-anọgide ka ọ dị.

en: {name_prefix}Your sales have been uneven lately.
To protect your business money, we suggest lowering your pension saving from {rate_cur} to {rate_new}.
This lowers your saving by about {monthly_change} every month.
To agree, reply YES to the text message we sent.
If you do nothing, your rate stays the same.
pidgin: {name_prefix}Your sales don dey up and down.
To protect your business money, we wan reduce your pension saving from {rate_cur} to {rate_new}.
E go reduce your saving by about {monthly_change} every month.
If you agree, reply YES for the text message wey we send.
If you no do anything, your rate go stay as e be.
yoruba: {name_prefix}Títà yín ti ń lọ sókè sódò láìpẹ́ yìí.
Láti dáàbò bo owó iṣẹ́ yín, a dábàá pé kí a dín ìfipamọ́ owó ìfẹ̀yìntì yín kù láti {rate_cur} sí {rate_new}.
Èyí yóò dín ìfipamọ́ yín kù ní bí {monthly_change} lóṣooṣù.
Tí ẹ bá fọwọ́ sí i, ẹ fèsì YES sí ìfiránṣẹ́ tí a rán sí yín.
Tí ẹ kò bá ṣe nǹkan kan, ìpín yín yóò wà bí ó ṣe wà.
hausa: {name_prefix}Sayarwarku ta yi sama da ƙasa kwanan nan.
Don kare kuɗin kasuwancinku, muna ba da shawarar mu rage ajiyar fansho naku daga {rate_cur} zuwa {rate_new}.
Wannan zai rage ajiyarku da kusan {monthly_change} kowane wata.
Idan kun yarda, ku amsa YES ga saƙon da muka aika.
Idan ba ku yi komai ba, adadin ajiyarku zai tsaya yadda yake.
igbo: {name_prefix}Ahịa gị adịghị ka ọ na-adị n'oge na-adịbeghị anya.
Iji chebe ego azụmahịa gị, anyị na-atụ aro ka anyị belata nchekwa ụgwọ ezumike nka gị site na {rate_cur} ruo {rate_new}.
Nke a ga-ebelata nchekwa gị site na ihe dị ka {monthly_change} kwa ọnwa.
Ọ bụrụ na ị kwenyere, zaa YES n'ozi anyị zitere.
Ọ bụrụ na ị emeghị ihe ọ bụla, oke gị ga-anọgide ka ọ dị.
